title: Just past the Freeway world, is an empty drained lake/resevoir/canal
content: It's always "south" of the freeway world, beyond where the roads, overpasses and "tracks" become crumbled and incomplete. There's a concrete path alongside the empty "lake" and a concrete wall you have to jump down to get in. The emptied part is huge, I can barely see the other side. I see groups of people a lot when I'm there, but I don't talk to them and they don't talk to me. They look shell shocked and weary, worn out clothing. I'm usually with a group also, I can vaguely know they are there and I speak to them, but I never see them clearly. I'm always walk "south" in this place, either jumping down into it or climbing up the wall to get out. Everything around this empty lake is crumbled and worn down, overgrown, apocalyptic looking.
